title: Creating a document and drawing in VectorCraft
text: There is no new_document tool: run file.new {width, height, title} (craftmcp.py new vectorcraft width=600 height=500 title=X). Draw with draw_shape {shape: rectangle|ellipse|polygon|star|line, fill/stroke as '#rrggbb', strokeWidth} and draw_path {points or SVG d}; objects stack in creation order. For many objects write a Python script that calls the tools instead of one command per object.
